_provenance.paragraph_numbering: ¶N per the numbering scheme defined in hand_lift_provenance.json (436 non-empty paragraphs, table cells included).
_provenance.instrument_note: MSCA-PF is a single-fellow, single-beneficiary action, not a consortium. Only HOST is a beneficiary legal entity. FELLOW, SUPERVISOR and CO_SUPERVISOR are natural persons. DATA_PARTNER, TRANSFER_PARTNER and VALIDATION_PARTNER are participating organisations without beneficiary status. 'Role token' means an identifier the work plan assigns work to, not a consortium seat.
_provenance.identity_spine_source: The draft names no person. FELLOW, SUPERVISOR and CO_SUPERVISOR identities come from operator input pack item 7 (identity spine, confirmed 2026-08-11), which is the same authority ticket 3 used for the selected_call.json spine note. HOST is named by the draft (cover block ¶8, §3.2 ¶425) and corroborated by item 7.
_provenance.unresolved_scope: MATE, MVCRI and AgroVIR carry draft-confirmed role, country and function. Their legal identity (input pack item 1) and participation mode (item 2) are Unresolved here and are folded at ticket 6, per plans/fieldwise_tickets.md tickets 5 and 6.
_provenance.fellowship_type_ref: Fellowship type and duration are not duplicated here. Their single authoritative home is call_binding/selected_call.json (European Fellowship, 30 months = 24 at ELTE + a 6-month non-academic placement at AgroVIR under CC-07).
